clauses.reason: Impact rules already explain which shards a path affects; reusing them keeps one explanation for selection and inheritance.

updates.rationale: Per-shard reuse lets an area-only fix rerun only its area while the conservative unexplained fallback and exact evidence identity keep reuse safe.
updates.statement: Readiness reuses, per inheritable member shard and with or without a selection provider, the passing evidence of the nearest verified member receipt when no path changed since it affects that shard. Impact rules, and a declared provider's coverage, decide which shards a path affects; a requires prerequisite of an affected shard is affected; a modified test file is an ordinary path; an unexplained path affects every shard; a journal-only suffix affects none. A shard without passing evidence of its exact command and matching inputs there reruns. Final always executes its complete declared gate, and batch admission and continuation never inherit. This governs member test inheritance wherever an earlier clause limits it to a provider or a journal-only suffix.

clauses.reason: A dependent cannot run without its producer, while an order-only prerequisite adds nothing a dependent needs.

updates.rationale: Only producers join a gate, so an area gate stays to its listed shards and what they consume.
updates.statement: A gate runs the shards it lists and the requires prerequisites whose output they need. A shard's after prerequisites only order it among shards the gate already runs and never add one. They do not gate it: it runs after their validation failure, all failures are reported together and the verdict stays failed. requires still gates, and an infrastructure error in either kind of prerequisite skips dependents.

decisions.reason: Validation is being split into area shards so that an area-only fix reruns only that area. All-or-nothing inheritance, available beyond journal-only suffixes only through a provider, reran every shard after any affected one, and order-only prerequisites pulled extra shards into a gate. The owner approved per-shard inheritance decided by the impact rules with or without a provider, conservative on unexplained paths, and gates that do not pull in shards an area change does not need. requires prerequisites still join a gate because they produce output their dependents need, and existing configurations list preparation only in the prepare gate.

transaction.reason: Apply the owner-approved per-shard inheritance and gate membership decision
